description: Create the similar-products settings of a product card (action="create"; 409 if they already exist) or change the binding mode of existing ones (action="update"; 404 if there are none — check with get_similar_cards). Changing the mode drops every bound card, category and collection, and switching back does not restore them — read them with get_similar_cards first and re-bind afterwards. After choosing SELECTED_CARDS or SELECTED_CATEGORIES_COLLECTIONS, bind the objects with manage_similar_cards_objects.

action.description: "create" for a card without settings, "update" to change the mode.

binding_mode.description: Similar-products binding mode: ALL_VARIANTS — every product of the store is similar; SELECTED_CARDS — only the product cards bound via manage_similar_cards_objects; SELECTED_CATEGORIES_COLLECTIONS — products of the bound categories and collections.

product_card_id.description: Product card ID (UUID) — the variant's product_card_id, not a product or variant ID.

name: set_similar_cards_mode
title: Create or change similar-products settings
